entities.title: Thrustbound
entities.summary: An original jetpack arcade game for the browser, made in Godot 4: assemble a rocket, fuel it and lift off, level after level.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/, the page's loader and headers in web/, the Worker that serves it behind the sign-in in worker/, and the Worker's tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
There is no server-side state: the best score is kept in the player's browser.
